THE PERSON BEHIND THE PURPOSE

Meet Sheba

Faith Sheba
Gamde

A belief in movement.
A commitment to keep going.

As the founder of Fit is Lit, Sheba brings a personal approach to fitness and everyday confidence. Her vision connects practical fitness resources with personal style, creating space for people and families to find their own fit.

Shiba Imprint is where that story comes together — with Fit is Lit at its heart and room for what comes next.
